title: PrivateEye Workflow Horizon Survival & Hazard Rate Analysis

step_windows.notes: Zero step failures across all 100 workflows in initial 5 steps.
State accumulation and dynamic hydration introduce first transient DOM races.
Individual step accuracy remains high (>98.7%), but compounded failure probability increases.
Deep horizon ceiling reaches 78.12% cumulative task completion.

theoretical_vs_empirical.alignment_note: Empirical survival (78.12%) closely tracks theoretical Bernoulli product (0.9879^20 = 78.36%), proving that degradation is governed by mathematical compounding of independent step trials rather than cognitive collapse.
